retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, centered jewelry pendant encrusted with diamonds against a pure black background for a luxury hip-hop aesthetic.
triggerTerms: high contrast black and white jewelry art

recipe.visualDefinition: A large, octagonal-framed monogram pendant rendered in high-detail diamonds and white gold, floating in a void of absolute black with sharp specular highlights and deep shadows.
coreVisualRelationships: Central subject isolated against a void
Internal geometric repetition of diamond facets
High contrast between brilliant white highlights and deep black negative space
Monolithic scale of the jewelry piece relative to the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large, centered monogram occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central vertical bar of the primary letterform.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular movement following the octagonal border, then inward to the secondary lettering nestled in the negative space.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive, flat black surrounding the subject to emphasize brilliance and luxury.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, blocky sans-serif with chamfered corners
letterConstructionRules: Letters are constructed as 3D physical objects
Surfaces are entirely filled with pavé-set round and baguette diamonds
Outer edges follow an octagonal path
Secondary text is integrated into the negative space of the primary letter
characterSpecificRedesigns: Primary letter acts as a container for smaller glyphs
Corners are clipped at 45-degree angles to match the octagonal frame
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, textured primary monogram containing smaller, flat-shaded or similarly textured secondary letters.

avoid: Gradients that aren't based on light reflection

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary heavy, blocky skeleton for diamond filling.
Essential for capturing the jewelry-like physical depth.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid black background with a subtle grainy texture. Center a large, 3D octagonal pendant shape with a pavé diamond texture and sharp white specular highlights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a vector tool, create a heavy block monogram. Apply a diamond-facet mask to the letters and add a metallic beveled edge to simulate a jewelry setting.

verificationChecks: Does the diamond texture have sharp, high-contrast highlights?
Is the overall shape an octagon?
Is the typography integrated into the jewelry form?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color fringing or chromatic aberration
Check that highlights do not wash out the letter shapes
Verify the symmetry of the octagonal frame
Confirm the texture looks like individual stones rather than a generic noise pattern
recipe.reuseFormula: Center a [Subject: Monogram/Object] encrusted in [Material: Pavé Diamonds] with [Lighting: High-Contrast Specular] against a [Background: Solid Black Void] to create a [Style: Luxury Hip-Hop] aesthetic.
